text:
incident-bot: paging @eric (oncall) for elevated 5xxs in gateway from 1723456600 to now :rotating_light:

eric: seeing spike in 502/504s, customers reporting timeouts. Dashboard -> per-route 5xx up ~7x. Investigating KV/prefix cache errors next to ingress.

maya: confirming, prefixed requests to model-router show lots of cache-miss fallbacks, latency jump ~200ms. Logs show repeated errors: 
```
prefix_cache: shard=12 key=sha256:4f7a... checksum_mismatch=true
kv_store: get(key) -> corrupted_value, rc=-EIO
router: fallback_to_storage=true, revalidate=true
```

alex: @eric can you repro a failing request? sharing curl output from edge: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: gateway
X-Request-Id: req_abc123
```

eric: repro confirmed on a few routes. Rate limited spikes look correlated with a background compaction on kv-primary ~1723456605. Ops timeline? @luis

luis: compaction job started rolling at 1723456580 to reclaim disk; noticed higher error rates on one shard and automated throttling kicked in. I paused compaction on shard-12 at 1723456790.

zoe: customer-facing impact: several small customers hit 5xx on embeddings endpoint, critical routes for paid users show degraded success rate ~92% -> 60% for 10m. Escalation to support in progress.

eric: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable bypass-cache for affected routes (route-level), 2) shift traffic off shard-12 via routing policy, 3) enable aggressive KV-retries with jitter. I'll run steps 1+2 now.

ops-bot: task: set route param bypass_prefix_cache=true for route embeddings/* by @eric -> succeeded (1723456832) :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: reroute job to move 25% of traffic away from shard-12 -> started (job id reroute-1723456835)

maya: after bypassing cache, 5xx rate dropped by ~60% within 90s. Latency back to normal baseline for most routes. Still seeing occasional checksum_mismatch logs.

eric: leaving a short-term patch: mark shard-12 read-only, create temporary replica from hot backups, and schedule deeper data integrity check. @luis can you start replica creation and integrity job?

luis: spinning up replica now, estimate 12m to create and warm. Also running a KV-scan to find corrupt keys; will seed a fix-list.

alex: captured a sample corrupted payload (sanitized): 
```
{ "prefix": "user:1234", "kv_meta": {"version": 42, "checksum": "deadbeef"}, "value": "<binary truncated>" }
```

eric: handoff note for oncall next shift: we've mitigated customer impact by bypassing the prefix cache and rerouting. Root cause likely compaction-induced partial writes or stale checksum in shard-12 leading to checksum_mismatch on reads. Current posture: degraded but stable, no ongoing mass 5xx.

zoe: customer comms: drafts prepared, no broad outage banner, notify affected customers individually.

ops-bot: incident severity -> S2 (customer-impacting but mitigated) by @eric
eric: next steps (owner tags):
- luis: complete replica + KV-scan and produce fixlist (ETA 30m)
- alex: collect sample corrupted keys and push to repo for root-cause analysis
- maya: monitor 5xx/tail latency and confirm regression tests for checksum detection
- zoe: coordinate customer follow-ups

luis: update: replica warm complete at 1723456905, starting swap test in canary lane.

eric: swap test looks good, moving 100% of shard-12 reads to replica at 1723456918. 5xx rates steady low. Switching incident to monitoring; if no regressions in 30m we'll close and file postmortem.

mayab: (typo) oops disregard

zoe: marking support tickets as 'in progress' and attaching mitigation notes.

eric: handoff to night oncall @alex (names are display-only) — summary: bypassed prefix cache, moved traffic off bad shard, replica swap done. Watch for checksum_mismatch recurrence and any write errors during compaction reschedule.

alex: ack, I'll take watch. :eyes:

incident-bot: incident thread closed to updates by @eric at 1723456920 (monitoring state).
